reconcileDrift: The picker currently copies into Imports and persists the raw temporary path as PhotoId, bypassing PrivateFileStore/observation_photos. There is no real restart-safe photo render path or explicit Keep/Replace/Remove lifecycle.
goal: Implement a two-phase restart-safe observation photo lifecycle using app-private managed storage and typed Keep/Replace/Remove semantics on Android and iOS, without broad media permissions or raw-path identity leakage.
acceptanceCriteria: System picker cancellation leaves draft and persisted state unchanged; successful bytes are first staged as a pending import and never persisted as a raw path or external URI.
Save imports into canonical app-private photo storage with deterministic safe identity and atomically commits the observation/photo row; failures compensate partial files and rows.

Editing exposes typed Keep, Replace and Remove. Replace deletes the prior managed file only after successful commit; Remove deletes the managed association/file without affecting observation text; orphan cleanup is deterministic and scoped.
Batch detail and observation editor resolve and render the managed photo after process restart; missing/corrupt files fail locally without crashing or losing core observation data.
Android Photo Picker and iOS PHPicker paths copy immediately into app-private staging and request no broad photo/media permission.
EN/RU production strings, accessibility semantics and deterministic previews cover add/keep/replace/remove, image description/privacy and failure states.
Deterministic platform, file-integration and component tests prove AC-074, plus Android assembly and all affected iOS Kotlin/Native compilations. Root owns Gradle and final goldens.
